question: Can hypnosis bring back lost memories?
answer: Hypnosis turns up how sure you feel, not how right you are, which is why many US courts bar or limit testimony "refreshed" by it. In the sketch, 16 of 60 drawings come to mind; the higher one floats, the surer it feels, and above the line you'd say "I remember."
move: Hypnosis turns up how sure you feel, not how right you are.

web.label: A horizontal recall line with 16 drawings floating above and below it, higher ones feeling surer, asking whether hypnosis can bring back lost memories. Anything above the line is one you would say you remember.
